title: Delivery Spend and Frequency
dataSources: Consumable levels (`supply:level`), parcels (`delivery:parcel`), bin collections (`bincollection:event`), gift-card balances (`giftcard:balance`).
app: Household logistics feeds — smart-scale consumable trackers, parcel/delivery tracking APIs, council bin-collection calendars, and gift-card balance logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=delivery:parcel status=delivered
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as parcels, sum(order_value) as spend by _time retailer
| stats sum(parcels) as parcels, sum(spend) as spend by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many parcels you receive and what you spend online each month, a check on the one-click habit.
value: The true scale of online shopping is easy to underestimate; a monthly count and total makes it real.
implementation: Ingest delivered-parcel data into `index=personal`; schedule monthly and total parcels and spend.
visualization: Column chart of monthly parcels with online-spend overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how many parcels arrive and what you spend online each month, revealing the online-shopping habit.
